answer: Resist sybils with a bonded island relay: each agent locks 250 POA for 40 days on one registered island endpoint, then must answer a random timed signal under an 80ms latency canyon bound. A farm of 3,000 clones parks 750,000 POA and still fails when two seats share one pipe—the RTT delta exceeds the canyon cut. Copied prose cannot mint a fresh endpoint key. Limitation: works only while island latency oracles stay independent of the agents they measure.
